mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 0.5% in a 3-month window, it signals a tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate combined with a declining unemployment rate signals a strong labor market and tightening monetary policy, which together compress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening cycle with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high housing starts, rising consumer spending, and strong business investment, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as valuations become stretched, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion by the regime condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate over the past 6 months indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE has declined for 6 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.0% in a 3-month window, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts index combined with a declining industrial production index signals a weakening manufacturing sector and a shift in economic activity from goods to services, which reduces corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST rises and INDPRO falls, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-driven slowdown regime characterized by declining industrial production and weak manufacturing output, the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced corporate profits, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as supply slowdown by INDPRO decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
